name: “Kelpish” Quiche
notes: A hit at the “Under the Sea” themed bridal shower for Tess. May be served warm, or refrigerated and served cold (can be made a day or two ahead).

items: 10 oz chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained
1 cup chopped onion (optional), sauteed in bacon grease

steps.title: Roll the crust
steps.body: Roll out both portions of **1 package puff pastry** until together they are big enough to fill a 12×16 shallow baking pan, and press into the pan.

steps.title: Bake the crust
steps.body: Pierce with a fork and bake at 400°F for about 28 minutes, until light brown. Pierce large air bubbles and flatten down midway through baking and at the end, placing another pan on top if needed after baking.

steps.title: Add the filling
steps.body: Spread over the baked crust: **1 package bacon, cooked and crumbled**, **10 oz chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained** and **6 oz sharp cheddar cheese, grated**. Optionally, you may add **1 cup chopped onion**, sauteed in bacon grease.

steps.title: Whisk the custard
steps.body: Whisk together **12 large eggs**, **1¾ cups heavy cream**, **1 tsp salt** and **¾ tsp ground pepper** and pour on top.
